topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: If an investment adviser manages your investment portfolio, they may charge you an ongoing annual fee based on the value of your portfolio.
question: How can an investment advisory fee affect your portfolio?
answer: An investment adviser may charge an ongoing annual fee based on your portfolio’s value. Because fees reduce the money in your portfolio that is earning a return, the fee can affect your returns over time.
